title: Stop Saying "Very Cold"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very cold". Try one of these instead:
• Freezing: freezing in this thin jacket
• Icy: an icy wind from the north
• Frozen: frozen fingers after the snowball fight
• Bitter: a bitter winter night
• Arctic: arctic weather all week

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
